intro: Can you set every slice straight?
description:
Think the picture will snap into place at a glance?

This casual rotation puzzle turns a neon night mood into a quick visual challenge. Each stage starts with one image split into slices, and every slice has been turned out of place.

How to play:
・Look over the whole image
・Rotate each slice until the picture lines up
・Clear the stage fast to aim for more stars

The rules are simple, but the pressure builds as the slices increase. Even a small twist can change the whole image, so sharp eyes and quick decisions make the difference.

Take on all 60 stages and see how smoothly you can bring the night back into focus.
